props.text:
When this invitation reaches you,
it means our wedding day is drawing near 
--the countdown has begun, and we are overjoyed to
welcome you into this chapter of our lives.

The best thing to 
hold onto in life is each other

Perhaps we have never fully told you our story.
Or perhaps, time and distance have kept us apart for a while.
But through sunrises and sunsets,
as the seasons quietly turn,
we have loved each other
simply deeply,
and wholeheartedly.

The best love is the kind
that awakens the soul and makes us reach for more,
that plants a fire in our hearts and
brings peace to our minds."

I will love you with all my
heart, now and forever

You are my moon, my
 stars,and my entire universe

When twilight syncs with heartbeats
 starlight dissolves into the softness of your gaze.
Grow old along with me, the best is yet to be
The ZenLove Holtel, TP Hà Nội
